visualCharacteristics.purpose: news mosaic where the first story is featured large and the others stack beside it
visualCharacteristics.summary: An asymmetric mosaic: the first card is large (2/3 width) and the other two stack beside it, titles on a translucent blue overlay.

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: image; cell 2: linked title. The first row is the featured card
contentPattern.notes: Each item links to a news detail page and the set changes daily. That makes it a dynamic list, so Cards.

usage: Daily news or highlights with 3 items: featured (2/3 width) plus two stacked cards, titles over the image.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any featured-plus-secondary news set. Use cards-tiles for an even grid.
